answer: Because the pulse release is entered with every signature, the quartz audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the fable graph and each risks its bond. The fee repeats 22 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
